runs.content: Valero trades at ~7x forward earnings after a 19% pullback from its high and returns about half of its operating cash flow, entered on a day when energy was the only sector to rise; GPN was exited at −13.19% after its take-private talks reportedly collapsed.

Fortive's Q3 beat (core growth +7.2%, adjusted EPS $0.77 vs ~$0.70) came with a raised FY26 EPS guide and ~$300M of buybacks, and the stock is drifting up to a 52-week high, +10.2% from its pre-report close; ULVR was trimmed for capacity at +0.31%.
